findings.text: follow-on: repository_identity_once memoises repository_identity in _REPOSITORY_IDENTITIES keyed by str(path), while its comment at lines 56-62 and the evidence fragment both claim the key is each path's git common directory; a worktree path and its mount therefore occupy two entries and each pay a probe, so the stated keying is not what the code does.

follow-on: the fragment repeats the "keyed by each path's git common directory" claim that dispatch_sections.py:66 does not implement, so a reader is told the identity probe is once per repository when it is once per path string.

follow-on: the item-4 divergence guard compares the docstring's quoted number against routing.SCRATCH_GRACE_SECONDS, not against the value garbage_collect_orphan_scratch applies, and test_the_orphan_sweep_uses_the_stated_grace at :225 only checks the source mentions the constant, so a sweep that stopped applying the age rule would not fail either test.

follow-on: the timed-driver measure asserts the second dispatch's pre-pick stages are under 0.5 s but passes identically at base in the fixture, so it does not discriminate the fix; the worker discloses this in the manifest follow_ons and the evidence fragment.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base e0497bd71; ab5883931 changes dispatch_sections.py, ledger.py and routing.py and adds the test file, e00169315 adds only the evidence fragment, and nothing falls outside scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when names tests/test_pre_pick_state_reads_once.py, the gate file list and a delta judgement; the manifest records base-arm-repro.log 4 failed/2 passed and head-arm.log 1 failed/260 passed against base-arm-gate.log 5 failed/256 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal was to make dispatch read its shared pre-pick state once and keep the four defective reads fixed — repository resolution, ledger index fallback, the estimate stamp and the scratch age rule; reckon/crew/dispatch_sections.py:66 adds repository_identity_once, reckon/ledger.py:979 adds _last_good_index_data's shared decode, reckon/crew/routing.py:3648 stamps every candidate plan file, and routing.py:2105 states the sweep's age rule.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records the gate results and names the four gate logs, and its baseline_suite/after_suite blocks reconcile with those logs' summaries (5 failed/256 passed and 1 failed/260 passed, both EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares reckon/crew/dispatch_sections.py, reckon/ledger.py, reckon/_store.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, the test file, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches only dispatch_sections.py, ledger.py, routing.py, the test file and the fragment, all inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_pre_pick_state_reads_once.py:142 is proven to redden by negative-control.log (EXIT=1) and :101 and :182 observe git probes and os.scandir independently, but the item-4 guard at :218 asserts only that the docstring quotes SCRATCH_GRACE_SECONDS' value, not that the sweep applies it.
justifications.evidence: base-arm-repro.log shows the four item tests red at base e0497bd71 and head-arm.log shows them green, but head-arm.log's header names e0497bd71 "plus working-tree change" rather than the committed head e00169315, so the 260-pass is not tied to the committed revision by the log alone.
justifications.fit: the additions follow the surrounding docstring-and-dict idiom of reckon/crew/dispatch_sections.py:52 and reckon/ledger.py:975 and introduce no name the naming rules forbid, though the comment at dispatch_sections.py:56-62 describes a keying the code does not do.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_sections.py:66 keys its memo by str(path) although the goal and its own comment say keyed by the git common directory, so a worktree and its mount stay two entries, but all four plan items are implemented and tested.
justifications.reuse: reckon/ledger.py:979 factors _index_payload out of _indexed_data so the refreshing and last-good reads share one decode, but reckon/crew/dispatch_sections.py:69 hand-rolls per-process memoisation where the repository already owns functools.lru_cache (reckon/ledger.py:213, reckon/crew/recovery.py:4503).
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff of e0497bd71..e00169315 — dispatch_sections.py, ledger.py, routing.py, the test file and the evidence fragment — is inside the manifest's declared write paths.
